title: Photo Booth Hire Hitchin | Boothdrop Entertainment
metaDescription: Photo booth hire in Hitchin, Letchworth and Baldock for barn weddings, golf club proms and office parties. Attendant and props included. Ask for a quote.
h1: Photo Booth Hire Hitchin and North Hertfordshire
intro: Hitchin is a busy market town in North Hertfordshire, ringed by villages whose barns, halls and golf clubs fill up with weddings and parties through the year. We arrive with the booth, a friendly attendant, a box of props and a print design built around your names or logo. Packages from £239, with delivery, setup and pack-down part of the price.

sections.heading: Our patch around Hitchin
paragraphs: Hitchin belongs to North Hertfordshire, and our Hertfordshire work takes in the whole district around it. Besides the town centre, we are regularly booked in Letchworth Garden City and Baldock, and in the villages of Ickleford, Pirton and Offley. Stevenage lies to the south-east and Luton to the south-west, so a party on either side of the town is an easy trip for our team.

Getting here is simple. Junction 8 of the A1(M) and the A505, A600 and A602 bring us in from every direction, which means the van is rarely more than a short drive from your venue once we leave the main roads.

sections.heading: Matching the booth to the room
paragraphs: Barns in the North Hertfordshire villages suit the Retro Pod well. Its printer is built into the body, so there is barely a cable to hide, it stands on a floor area of 1.5 by 1.5 metres and it produces classic photo strips that sit naturally among timber beams and fairy lights. For golf club and hotel weddings, the Selfie Mirror Pod brings an oval LED-framed mirror and a DSLR camera, fits up to eight people in a frame and gives each of them an instant print.

School halls hosting proms and leavers' parties often call for the Party Booth. Its curtain and wood-panelled walls give teenagers a private space for up to eight at once, and a school hall usually offers the 2.4 metres of headroom it needs. Business events in town-centre function rooms lean towards the GIF Booth, which skips prints entirely and sends boomerangs, stills and animated clips straight to phones by email or QR code.

sections.heading: Advice for each type of occasion
paragraphs: Every event has its own rhythm, and the right booth timing depends on it. Weddings work best with the booth opening after the meal, once speeches are done. Proms peak in the first hour after arrival, while everyone still looks immaculate. Birthday parties want the booth running from the start so younger guests have something to gravitate towards, and Christmas parties benefit from a hire window that overlaps the dancing. Share your running order and we will suggest a start time and length to suit.
list: Weddings: open the booth once the speeches finish
Proms: schedule from arrival while outfits are fresh
Corporate: brand the overlay and collect clips for social channels
Birthdays: run from the first guest so the fun starts early
Christmas parties: overlap the hire with the disco
Guest book: place it beside the print table for messages

sections.heading: Barns, golf clubs and function rooms in North Herts
paragraphs: Converted barns in the surrounding villages are the wedding venue many local couples choose, with lofty interiors that make room for any of our booths. Golf clubs take a good share of receptions, proms and anniversary dinners, and hotels host the larger corporate evenings. In the town itself, function rooms above shops, pubs and clubs are popular for milestone birthdays and engagement parties.

Village halls remain the mainstay of family celebrations, from christenings to retirement do's, and school halls host fundraisers, discos and summer fairs. Each venue type has its quirks, whether that is a curfew, a first-floor room or a single socket on a far wall, and we ask about them before the day.

sections.heading: Getting in, setting up and plugging in
paragraphs: Our attendant needs somewhere to pull up near the door, unload and then move the vehicle to a parking space. Barns and golf clubs normally have plenty of room for this. Town-centre function rooms can be more awkward, so we agree a loading point with the venue or with you in advance and follow any time restrictions they set.

Building the booth takes 45 to 60 minutes, and we finish before your hire begins, so none of that time comes out of your booking. A single standard socket close to the booth position runs every booth except the Inflatable Booth, which needs two. If the room is up a flight of stairs with no lift, let us know at the outset and we will recommend one of our slimmer, easily carried booths.

sections.heading: What comes with every booking
paragraphs: Whichever booth you pick, the booking includes a professional attendant for the whole hire, unlimited sessions, props, LED lighting and public liability insurance. Your print or overlay is designed with your own text and logo, print booths come with a guest book, and every guest can have digital copies by email and share them on social media. Green screen backdrops can be added on request. Couples and event organisers have rated us 5 stars on Trustpilot.

faqs.q: Where can you park and unload for a Hitchin venue?
faqs.a: Barns, golf clubs and hotels usually have a car park right by the entrance, so we unload there and park. For function rooms in the town centre we arrange a loading point beforehand, unload quickly and then move the vehicle to nearby parking while the booth is built.

faqs.q: Our function room is on the first floor. Will that work?
faqs.a: It can, provided we know before the day. Our slimmer booths, such as the LCD SlimPod and the Retro Pod, are easy for two of us to carry upstairs. Larger booths like the Magic Mirror are better suited to ground-floor rooms or venues with a lift.

faqs.q: Is there a travel charge for Hitchin and nearby towns?
faqs.a: Delivery and setup are included. If any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue, it is shown on the quote up front, so there is nothing unexpected later. Hitchin, Letchworth Garden City, Baldock and the nearby villages are all part of our regular area.

faqs.q: Can you cover a wedding in one of the barns near Pirton or Offley?
faqs.a: Yes. Village barns around Hitchin are among the venues we work in most. Let us know where the nearest socket is and whether the floor is level, and we will recommend a booth that suits the space and the look of the room.

faqs.q: Do you do school proms in North Hertfordshire?
faqs.a: We do. Proms in school halls, golf clubs and hotels are a regular booking for us. Many schools pick the Party Booth for its privacy, and we can add the school name, year group and date to every print.
